request.spec:
The consolidated figures gain, per grade on any sheet of the tree, the due-totals of the people on
that grade (retired people left out) added up over the tree, and per status the count of claims in
that status over the tree.
request.prompt:
You are implementing ONE change to this application.

FIRST read AGENTS.md — it states the working rules and how the app is tested, and sends you to
DESIGN.md for the app's stack and conventions. Follow both.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
The consolidated figures gain, per grade on any sheet of the tree, the due-totals of the people on
that grade (retired people left out) added up over the tree, and per status the count of claims in
that status over the tree.

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, test data and any audit
records it expects — match them. Run `bin/e2e` to build the app, start it, and run the test as
you work; iterate until it passes. Change whatever the request needs across the app — its stored
data, its server and its front end. Do NOT edit bin/build, bin/start, bin/stop, bin/e2e,
AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, DESIGN.md, e2e/support/ or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
The consolidated figures now include the two new breakdowns, and all 4 acceptance tests pass under `bin/e2e`.

- **Per grade (A, B, C):** `consolidated-grade-<G>-due-total` adds up, over the sheet and all the sheets below it, the due-totals of each grade's people. Retired people are left out and people with no due-total are skipped.
- **Per status (DRAFT, OPEN, PENDING, SETTLED, VOID, REVIEW):** `consolidated-status-<S>-count` counts the claims in that status across the same set of sheets.

Each sheet's numbers are worked out the same way its own summary table does it, then added up across the tree. Like the existing people, due and overdue totals, the new figures follow the screen's as-of date.

Everything is in the front end, in `src/main/frontend/features/consolidated/consolidated.slot.tsx`. The server and stored data needed no changes, because the figures come from data the screen already loads.
